    Parsley 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT API

    Parsley is a Java library for causal consistency over Kafka. It ensures that every consumer processes messages in the correct causal order, even when records originate from multiple topics and partitions, by encoding each message's causal dependencies onto it and buffering records until those dependencies have been observed.

    The entire public surface lives in a single package, io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley, and consists of interfaces and value types; every implementation is package-private and obtained through a static factory (CausalProcessors, CausalDependencies, CausalTopics).

    Core concepts

    Causal dependencies
    The positions a consumer must have observed before a record stamped with them may be delivered — a producer's snapshot of what it had seen when it sent the record. Carried as CausalDependencies in a parsley-causal-dependencies header. Build one from a consumed record with from, combine several for a fan-in with merge, and attach it to an outbound record with stamp.
    Causal frontier
    The highest offset a causal processor has admitted on each topic-partition, keyed by topic UUID so that topic deletion and recreation produce a distinct identity even when the name is reused. A record is delivered once the frontier dominates its dependencies. The frontier is internal to CausalProcessors; it is not a separate public type.
    Causal buffer
    Records whose dependencies are not yet satisfied are held in a changelog-backed buffer and released as soon as the frontier catches up. A CausalBufferLimit bounds how long or how large the buffer may grow; Parsley never drops or diverts a record — when the limit fires, the held record is forwarded anyway, out of causal order, logged and counted as a violation.

    Entry points

    TypePurpose
    CausalProcessorSupplierWraps a user Kafka Streams Processor so its state access and forwards run behind the causal guarantee; built via CausalProcessors.
    CausalDependenciesStamps and reads causal dependencies directly on plain ProducerRecord/ConsumerRecord objects, for talking to a Parsley topology from outside Kafka Streams.

    Typical usage

    
// Inside a Kafka Streams topology
builder.stream(List.of("prices", "orders"), Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), orderSerde))
       .process(CausalProcessors.builder(userSupplier)
               .addBufferStore("parsley", CausalBufferLimit.ofDuration(limit))
               .addBuffer(CausalBuffer.of("prices", Serdes.String(), priceSerde))
               .addBuffer(CausalBuffer.of("orders", Serdes.String(), orderSerde))
               .build())
       .to("output-topic");

// At the edge, from a plain Kafka client
CausalDependencies deps = CausalDependencies.from(topics, consumedRecord);
producer.send(deps.stamp(new ProducerRecord<>("orders", key, value)));
